records.name: Grand Award history: 1983 to 2005, regained 2021
description_facts: Recognised by Wine Spectator since 1983, winning the Grand Award every year until 2005
Hurricane Katrina destroyed the vaulted wine collection in 2005 and ended the streak
Regained the Grand Award in 2021 and has held it through 2026
records.snippet: The world-famous Brennan's Restaurant has been recognized by Wine Spectator since 1983, having taken home the Grand Award every year. However, in 2005, the restaurant's annual winning streak ended after Hurricane Katrina destroyed its vaulted wine collection. Brennan's took back its Grand Award in 2021, and has continued to maintain this prestigious recognition through 2026.
